Left alone, a router tends to collapse: the experts that start a little better get more tokens, learn more, and get even more — the rest stop learning.

E · The cost, measured on this CPU

About the same arithmetic per token is not the same time. The router, sorting tokens into experts and many small matrix products add work. A big batch on a GPU hides that; a CPU does not. Large models accept the cost: their experts sit on different GPUs, and what counts is how much a model can know per unit of compute.
